headline: CHINA HOARDS SILVER at record pace as global demand goes parabolic
snippet: China's silver imports hit 836 tonnes in March 2026 — 173% above the 10-year seasonal average — driven by solar manufacturers front-loading ahead of the April 1 export-rebate removal and retail investors using silver as a cheaper gold proxy. Q1 2026 total silver imports reached 1,626 metric tonnes, the highest opening quarter on record, tightening global physical inventories in London and New York to razor-thin levels.

headline: ALLIED GOLD Q1 OUTPUT UP 14%, Zijin's C$5.5B deal inches toward May 29 close
snippet: Allied Gold (TSX: AAUC) produced 96,016 oz gold in Q1 2026, up 14% year-over-year, as its Sadiola Phase 1 mill expansion in Mali reached completion. The company confirmed normal operations across all three African jurisdictions — Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia — and said both parties are in active dialogue to hit the May 29 outside-closing date on Zijin Gold's C$5.5 billion all-cash takeover.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD HITS IN ALL 9 HOLES at Ben Ben: 1km gold trend confirmed in 16km Liberia district
snippet: Zodiac Gold's maiden diamond drill program at the Ben Ben target within its Todi Gold Project in Liberia intersected gold mineralization in every one of the nine assayed holes along the southern trend, with standout results including 14.85m at 1.55 g/t Au and 17.65m at 0.81 g/t Au. The company is now mapping a 16km district-scale corridor and targeting a first NI 43-101 resource estimate for Q4 2026.

headline: FOREMOST CLEAN ENERGY pushes Hatchet Lake South uranium zone 100m further north
snippet: Foremost Clean Energy (CSE: FAT / NASDAQ: FMST) extended the Tuning Fork Uranium Zone at its Hatchet Lake South project in the eastern Athabasca Basin with hole TF-26-36, returning new mineralization 100 metres north of prior drilling and including a peak intercept of 1.0% eU₃O₈ over 1.4m. Approximately 600m of untested conductive strike length remains open to the south for follow-up drilling.

headline: KGHM Q1 PROFIT TRIPLES on copper surge: Europe's largest copper miner beats forecasts by 51%
snippet: Polish copper and silver miner KGHM posted Q1 2026 net profit of PLN 3.53 billion — three times the prior year and 51% above analyst consensus — as record copper prices combined with a 35% drop in C1 cash costs to $1.69/lb. EBITDA more than doubled to PLN 5.46 billion; silver production rose 54% year-over-year, confirming the company's leverage to both metals simultaneously.

headline: ELEMENTAL ROYALTY BUYS VIZSLA for C$327M — secures uncapped NSR on Mexico's Panuco silver-gold project
snippet: Elemental Royalty Corp. (TSX: ELE) agreed on May 13 to acquire Vizsla Royalties for C$327 million — a 31% premium to Vizsla's 20-day VWAP — gaining a 2%–3.5% uncapped NSR royalty on Vizsla Silver's Panuco silver-gold development project in Sinaloa, Mexico. The royalty carries no buyback provisions and no step-down clauses, making this one of the cleanest royalty structures in the mid-tier silver space.

headline: ENERGY STORAGE BOOM RESCUES LITHIUM: data center demand and China EV push reset demand forecasts
snippet: China's plan to double national EV charging capacity to 180 GW by 2027 and surging demand from AI data center power-storage systems are bolstering lithium demand forecasts well above earlier projections. Lithium carbonate prices have recovered 14.6% in the past month and are up 197% year-over-year, providing relief for producers who endured the prolonged 2024–25 price collapse.
